reviewProtocol: Existing shared route and lateral plan, transformed with native-to-browser basis. A/B are matched. Half-block has a different, longer source route.

observations.observation: 0–5.88s: the longer residential route is recognizable, but major road/tree smearing obscures detail.
6–7.25s: white-house edges and branches double; 9.88s near-ground texture stretches.
4.00s: roof/window detail is lost in foliage and haze; 5.88s buildings have soft duplicated contours.
0.00s: recording-car-colored foreground smear; 4.00s large road streaks and 6.00s ghosted facades.
Broader route than the short tests, but major local distortions break usable continuity. This is an open half-block, not a validated closed block.

comparisons: This is a different, longer capture. Its poor result does not isolate length as the cause.
Recorded source-view PSNR 16.03 / SSIM .494 / LPIPS .526; the experiment quality target failed. No Postshot output was produced in that run.
limits: AI-assisted editorial assessment of eight labelled samples per model, with links to the complete 80-sample review and existing native evidence. Not an independent human panel.
No real-time FPS, fine temporal flicker, physical-phone thermal test, surveyed scale or independent novel-view truth measured.
Human effort and end-to-end elapsed time unknown; source-view metrics are not lateral geometric accuracy.
Different captures, routes, training budgets and encodings make cross-group ranking a provisional asset-utility judgment, not an algorithm leaderboard.
